verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents configurable AML/watchlist screening (sumsub-docs-6) and a generic webhook system for verification-related events and changes (sumsub-docs-3), which together imply an ops lead could be notified of screening changes, but the evidence never explicitly confirms ongoing/continuous re-screening of already-approved applicants against watchlist updates or that such updates specifically fire webhook events. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated periodic re-screening post-approval, and confirmation that watchlist-update hits generate a distinct actionable event/webhook type.
